comparison_for_scientific_classification: selected Render-Refined Coefficient versus Teacher Endpoint on the 20 held-out test cells; equal-step Full-Residual supplies span capacity context

decision_order.when: required assets, metric cells, safety reviews, parity, or denominator provenance are missing; this is evaluated before scientific classes
safe, >=4 garments improve LPIPS, macro LPIPS absolute and relative thresholds pass, companion gate passes, macro span recovery ratio>=0.25 with >=3 valid garment ratios
safe and >=4 garments improve LPIPS, but one or more useful-headroom magnitude/recovery gates fail while macro LPIPS improvement remains >0
no safe coefficient positive class, while safe equal-step Full-Residual improves >=4 garments and passes both full-residual macro LPIPS thresholds
none of the preceding rules pass; unsafe coefficient candidates count as no stable improvement

definitions.companion_gate: RGB MAE improves by 0.002 OR boundary F improves by 0.02 OR silhouette IoU improves by 0.01
definitions.macro: equal mean over five garments after equal mean over four rotations
definitions.not_optimize_only: held-out test LPIPS gate itself passes; optimize-fold change alone never qualifies
definitions.per_garment_lpips_improved: mean over four held-out rotations decreases by at least 0.001 versus Teacher Endpoint
definitions.safe: identity contamination=0 and component contamination=0; unsafe apparent gains are not positive headroom
